rules.build:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS"
chmod +x generate_descriptor_proto.sh ./generate_descriptor_proto.sh
cp -a python python3
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/python3" bh_python_install --py3 --build
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/python3"
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/python3" bh_python_install --py3 --install --root "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/python3"
